_note: The Day 5 (Data Exfiltration) work order. Same format as day4_recovery.json. attacks: the Response patterns that got through become these repairs. Components: folders (PermissionGrid: which computer may send where), rotate (OrderSteps: change the key of the service account), archive (AccountAction with files: find the leftover archive and delete it, then choose whom to tell), file_server (the final check, FileServerRepair).

room.controls: WASD / arrows: move     E: use     Esc: pause
room.waiting_body: Response has not confirmed that the leak is stopped. You can look around, but the equipment must stay dark until it is.
room.all_done: Checks complete. Return to the office entrance to finish.
room.summary_body: The repairs and the final check passed.
room.summary_lesson: Close the door, change the key, find what is left, then tell the people who must know, plainly and honestly.
room.unknown_damage: Unsupported damage: {ids}. A matching recovery task is needed.
room.hardening_unavailable: No hardening results have been supplied.
room.verify_locked: Finish the required restoration work before the final access checks.
room.not_required: This equipment does not need restoration in this work order.

comments.clean: Joshua: Door closed, key changed, archive gone, and the right people told. Not one wrong move.
comments.done: Joshua: Everything is fixed. Next time, think about what the logs show before you decide.

task_ui.hint: Take your time. Read the labels before choosing.

case.brief: The leak is stopped, but the door is still open. db-01 may still send data to places nobody approved, the key of the account svc-report was never changed, and a leftover archive is still on the server. Fix each one, then check that nothing is still leaking.
case.lesson: Allow only the places data is meant to go, change a key that was never changed, and tell the people who must know.

folders.title: Close the door: firewall rules
folders.instruction: db-01 and web-01 can still send data to places nobody approved. Turn off the places a computer does not need, and keep the ones its job needs.
folders.lesson: Allow only the places data is meant to go. Anything else stays closed.
folders.heading: Where each computer may send
folders.pick: Turn off the places a computer does not need. Keep what its job needs.
folders.extra: That computer does not need this place. Leave it off.

rows.label: db-01
rows.reason: db-01 sends the nightly backup to the backup cloud. That is its job, so that place stays open.

rows.label: backup-01
rows.reason: backup-01 copies the backups to the backup cloud. If that is closed, there are no backups.

rows.label: web-01
rows.reason: web-01 fetches updates and sends the hourly summary to the partner. Both are part of its job.

rows.label: Reception laptop
rows.reason: The laptop does not need to send anything directly.

folders.success: Every computer may send only to its own places. 198.51.100.23 is closed for all of them.

rotate.title: Change the key: svc-report
rotate.instruction: The password of svc-report has never been changed, and the thief used it. Change it without breaking the report that needs it. Put the six steps in the right order.
rotate.lesson: A password that never changes is a door that never closes. Make the new key first, then retire the old one.
rotate.heading: Change the key, in order
rotate.pick: Click the first step. Then the next, and so on.
rotate.wrong: That step is not next yet. Think about what has to happen before it.

steps.label: Create a new, long password
steps.done: A new password exists. The old one still works for now.
steps.early: Make the new password first. Without it there is nothing to change to.

steps.label: Give the new password to the job that needs it
steps.done: The monthly report job has the new password.
steps.early: The job gets the new password only after it exists.

steps.label: Test that the job still works
steps.done: The report job ran with the new password.
steps.early: Test the job after it has the new password, and before the old one is turned off.

steps.label: Disable the old password
steps.done: The old password stops working. The thief's copy is useless now.
steps.early: Do not turn the old password off before the job works with the new one, or the report breaks.

steps.label: Remove the old password from every place it was saved
steps.done: The old password is gone from the scripts and the notes.
steps.early: Remove the saved copies after the old password is disabled, so nothing tries it again.

steps.label: Write down who owns the account
steps.done: svc-report now has an owner. Nobody will forget it again.
steps.early: Write the owner down last, when the account is in order.

rotate.success: svc-report has a new key, the report still works, and someone owns the account.

archive.title: Find what is left, then tell
archive.instruction: A leftover archive of the customers is on db-01. Find it by its odd hour, delete it, then choose whom to tell.
archive.lesson: Find what is left, then tell the people who must know, plainly and honestly.
archive.heading: Which file is the leftover archive?
archive.pick: Click a file to read about it. Then press DELETE FILE.
archive.choose: Click a file to read about it.

accounts.label: tmp_cache.zip
accounts.detail: 480 MB, in the temp folder of db-01. Made at 03:12 and deleted at 05:40, every night.

accounts.label: backup.tar
accounts.detail: 9 GB. Made at 01:00 by the nightly backup, and kept for 30 days.
accounts.reason: That is the nightly backup. It is approved and it is our only copy. Deleting it would hurt us, not the thief.

accounts.label: live.db
accounts.detail: The live customer database, used by Support all day.
accounts.reason: That is the live database. Deleting it would stop Support, and the data is still needed.

accounts.label: summary.csv
accounts.detail: 3 MB. Made every hour for the analytics partner.
accounts.reason: That is the agreed partner report. It is small, regular and approved. It is not the leak.

accounts.label: march.xlsx
accounts.detail: 4 MB. The March report, opened by Marta.
accounts.reason: That is Marta's report. It has nothing to do with the leak.

accounts.label: guide.pdf
accounts.detail: 2 MB. The staff handbook in the shared folder.
accounts.reason: That is the staff handbook. It never left, and it is not private.

archive.disabled: tmp_cache.zip is deleted. Nothing of the archive is left on db-01. Now, whom do you tell?
archive.talk_heading: Whom do you tell, and how?

talk.label: Announce it to the whole company, with a loud alarm
talk.reason: Most people are not affected, and panic helps nobody. Tell the people who must know.

talk.label: Tell the manager and the customers affected, plainly
Tell nobody and hope nobody noticed
talk.reason: The customers already got spam. They will find out anyway, and they deserve to hear it from us first.

archive.success: The leftover archive is deleted, and the manager and the customers affected will be told plainly. The truth comes from us.

file_server.title: Back to work
file_server.instruction: Check that nothing is still leaking. Each check proves one repair worked.
file_server.lesson: Recovery is finished only when nothing is leaking and you have checked it.

checks.label: THE JOB
checks.expected: Trusted record: the job sync_cache should be gone.
checks.passed: The job sync_cache is gone. Nothing runs at 03:10.
checks.failed: The job sync_cache still runs. Recovery stays open.

checks.label: TRANSFERS
checks.expected: Trusted record: db-01 should not reach 198.51.100.23.
checks.passed: db-01 cannot reach 198.51.100.23. The transfers are blocked.
checks.failed: db-01 can still reach 198.51.100.23. Recovery stays open.

checks.label: THE KEY
checks.expected: Trusted record: svc-report should have a new password.
checks.failed: svc-report still has the old password. Recovery stays open.

file_server.all_checks: Run every check before confirming recovery.
file_server.failed: A check failed. Keep recovery open and ask the response team to address the result.
file_server.success: The job is gone, the transfers to the unknown host are blocked, and svc-report has a new key. Nothing is leaking.

response_outcome.summary: Response stopped the leak. The door, the key and the leftover archive are ready for repairs.
